name: Queen Mary University of London
summary: A large east London university with subjects from economics and law to medicine and dentistry; IB offers are often 34–36 points.

ib.text: Each course sets points and three HL grades, e.g. 34 with 6,6,5 (Applied Artificial Intelligence) or 36 with 6,6,6 (Accounting and Finance, Economics); some also ask a minimum SL Maths grade.

programmes.name: Medicine (5 Year Programme)
programmes.about: Five years to become a doctor, seeing patients from your first week in community and hospital settings, with modules you choose yourself, from the fundamental and clinical sciences to psychological and social ones.
programmes.ib: 37 points with 6,6,6 at HL, including Chemistry or Biology plus one more science at HL (Chemistry, Biology, Physics or Maths).
programmes.selectionNote: UCAT in the fourth decile or above and SJT band 1-3 to be shortlisted, then an online interview in January-February. Up to 24 places go to overseas applicants.

flagshipSource.title: Medicine: seeing patients from the first week, in community and hospital settings (course page)

programmes.name: Applied Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: Practical AI projects set by researchers and industry from year 1, teaching from academics involved in the ATLAS experiment at CERN, and a 60-credit Applied AI in Industry project in your final year.
programmes.ib: 34 points with 6,6,5 at HL, including HL Maths, Computer Science or Physics.
programmes.selectionNote: Offers follow the IB points and HL grades. No admissions test or interview is listed on the course page.

flagshipSource.title: Applied AI: projects set by researchers and industry, and a 60-credit industry project (course page)

programmes.name: Theatre and Performance
programmes.about: Theatre and performance studied in practice and in theory, working with the BLOC Arts Centre and partners such as the V&A, the Barbican, the Live Art Development Agency and Shakespeare's Globe, with an optional year abroad.
programmes.ib: 30 points with 5,5,5 at HL. No HL subject is named.
programmes.selectionNote: Offers follow the IB points and HL grades; no audition or portfolio is listed on the course page.

flagshipSource.title: Theatre and Performance: the BLOC Arts Centre; partners include the V&A, Barbican and Shakespeare's Globe (course page)

notes: Overseas fees for 2027 entry are £30,950 a year for Accounting and Finance, £34,750 for Applied AI and £56,650 for Medicine.
Queen Mary also teaches a five-year MBBS in Malta, applied for directly (not via UCAS) by 1 March 2027.
Medicine in London asks for a UCAT score in the fourth decile or above and an SJT band of 1–3.

faculties.name: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
faculties.line: Law, business, economics, politics, languages, film, history, geography; e.g. 30 points for Theatre, 36 for Economics.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science and Engineering
faculties.line: AI, chemistry, engineering, maths and physics; Applied AI asks 34 points with 6,6,5 and HL Maths, Computer Science or Physics.

faculties.name: Faculty of Medicine and Dentistry
faculties.line: Medicine: UCAT fourth decile or above and SJT band 1-3, then an online interview; apply by 15 October.
